title: Auto Loans: Confirming the Relationship Discount from Checking Records
content:
For an Auto Loans enrollment in autopay, the relationship discount is not taken on trust from the loan's recorded discount list. It is confirmed against the borrower's checking records, as this note explains.

## Rule

The enrolled rate includes the relationship discount when some checking account of a qualifying tier was open on the loan's funding date. Open on that date means opened that day or before, with no closure recorded on or before that day. The later history of the account does not count against the borrower: an account closed at any point after the funding date still establishes the discount. Nor does a later account count for the borrower: one opened only once the loan had funded cannot establish it. With no account that qualifies, the enrolled rate carries no relationship discount.

Tier, opening date and closing date all come from the checking records. Accounts of tiers that do not qualify are disregarded.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical loan funded on 5 January 2029)

- A qualifying account opened on 5 January 2029: establishes the discount, since opening on the funding date is enough.
- A qualifying account opened in 2025 and closed on 5 January 2029: does not, since a closure on the funding date means the account was not open that day.
- A qualifying account opened in 2025 and closed on 6 January 2029: establishes it.
- A qualifying account opened on 6 January 2029: does not.
- An account in a tier that does not qualify, open throughout: does not.

## Basis Q&A

**The loan's recorded discount list names relationship, but no qualifying account was open on the funding date. Is the discount confirmed?** No. Confirmation comes from the checking records alone.
